correctness.rationale: The six-dimensional equilibrium equations are solved without approximations. Noncompliant-population balance has exactly one interior root because its quadratic has opposite-sign roots and its values at 0 and b/delta have opposite signs. For each positive pressure the susceptible M-matrix and infectious transfer M-matrix possess strictly positive inverses. Differentiating the susceptible equations shows each susceptible component is strictly decreasing in pressure (alpha<1). Therefore the rank-one pressure consistency F(lambda) decreases strictly from the true next-generation spectral radius to zero. Exactly one positive equilibrium exists iff this threshold exceeds 1, and none otherwise. Explicit elimination yields a quadratic, and recovered compartments and total/noncompliant balance are verified independently for self-consistency. Rational script verify.py replays six vector-field residuals, all six fractions, scalar pressure and both threshold values and prints VERIFY_OK. The checker is finite arithmetic; global classification follows from the written analytic proof, not from numeric enumeration.

originality.rationale: Only the complete strictly positive endemic-equilibrium count and scalar quadratic reduction for the specified source model, with 0<xi<1 and the stated controls, are claimed as new. The source expressly leaves that equilibrium problem unfinished, expecting a quartic. Earlier analysis of the same v3 source already corrected its printed reproduction formula and produced a disease-free local-stability reversal; that earlier claim does not assert endemic existence/uniqueness and its correction is NOT claimed as new. Generic next-generation methods and the closely related author-group models do not imply an exact global positive-equilibrium count without the new noncompliant-total closure and strict M-matrix pressure monotonicity. The full relevant source equations and primary PDFs were compared. Coverage by unindexed work is a residual risk, not a uniqueness proof.
residual_risks: An indexed or unindexed recent paper may have independently solved the full endemic-equilibrium count without using the same terminology.

value.rationale: The motivating study explicitly leaves the number of endemic equilibria unknown and expects a quartic. A full nontrivial existence-and-uniqueness theorem for every interior behavioral-mixing parameter and fixed control turns this into a sharp one-dimensional quadratic threshold and a checkable physical equilibrium. Local invasion instability alone does not provide any of those facts, so the result is a genuine structural completion, not a notation correction, arbitrary parameter slice or routine numerical example. It supports validation of equilibria and parameter-regime interpretations without claiming global stability or empirical forecasts.
